source: Washington State Investment Board Private Equity IRR
selection_method: All reported WSIB private-equity fund holdings with an initial investment year of 2012 or later and positive paid-in capital; no manager- or sector-based filter.
important_limitations: These are one pension investor's holdings, not an industry-wide fund-return estimate.
Valuations are reported fund NAV, not transaction valuation multiples.
Investment year reflects the reporting LP's first investment and may differ from fund vintage.
